items.label: la cave
items.scene: A CALF (KAHV) naps on a bed of straw at the foot of the stone steps, down here in the vaulted wine CELLAR.

items.label: la bouteille
items.scene: A BOOT (boo-TEHY) is stuck upside down in the neck of a huge green BOTTLE standing on the cellar floor.

items.label: la brasserie
items.scene: A grey-moustached waiter hurries his tray of empty shiny BRASS tankards (brah-suh-REE) up to the BRASSERIE.

items.label: l'appellation
items.scene: An old winemaker leans on his barrel and presses a big red wax seal onto a bottle: by decree, a wine of NAMED ORIGIN (ah-pay-lah-SYOHN, like 'a-PELL-ation').

items.label: l'ivresse
items.scene: EVE won't REST (ee-VREHS): barefoot in the grape tub she stomps and stomps, beaming and laughing, purple juice splashing round her purple feet: the joyful, HEADY THRILL of grape-stomping day. Nothing in her hands, no glass.

items.label: la dégustation
items.scene: A white goat sniffs glass after glass at the little TASTING table, unsure whether to be DISGUSTED (day-GEWS-) or delighted; nobody drinks.

items.label: la capsule
items.scene: A squirrel wears a shiny bottle CAP as a helmet (kahp-SEWL) while hugging his acorn: a CAPSULE hat!

items.label: la vodka
items.scene: A crow perched on the ice bucket croaks 'KAH!' (vod-KAH) at the frosty VODKA bottle chilling inside.

items.label: la vigne
items.scene: A TEENY gnome (VEENY) stands at the foot of the stone pillar wrapped in a curling grape VINE heavy with purple bunches.

items.label: le verre
items.scene: A woman balances a GLASS of red wine on her head and shrugs 'WHERE?' (VEHR): it is right on top of her!
